title: Bar Drop Blueberry Cotton Candy 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Blueberry Cotton Candy is a playful and confectionery-inspired blend that balances deep fruit notes with airy sweetness. The profile leads with the rich, slightly tart taste of ripe Blueberry, providing a rich and authentic berry base. This is seamlessly woven into the sugary, light sweetness of spun sugar on the exhale. The extra-concentrated recipe amplifies the contrast between the dark berries and the sweet confectionery elements, resulting in a vibrant and satisfying vape. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is specifically designed for MTL/RDL vaping. When paired with stater vape kits and low-wattage tanks, it produces small vapour clouds alongside exceptional flavour clarity. The even consistency ensures optimal wicking and performance in MTL/RDL devices, providing a smooth and satisfying experience. The Bar Drop Shortfill collection takes the intensely concentrated flavour profiles typically found in "bar salt" ranges and presents them in a 50%-VG format. Supplied as 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, there is space to add a single 10ml nicotine shot, allowing you to easily create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. This offers a cost-effective and highly flavoursome solution for sub-ohm vapers.
